==Description==
'''Lighthaos''' is a [[Maps|map]] that takes place on an island with a broken lighthouse.

==Design & Path==
'''Lighthaos''' takes place on an island located in the middle of the ocean. The entire map has a red tint. On the island, there are only two buildings, a broken lighthouse and a small house. A hanging light can be seen coming out of the lighthouse. On the coastlines of the map, there are multiple active flares and crashed ships. A few cliffs can also be seen around the map.

The path starts at a cave under the lighthouse and ends at a portal next to the house.

==Interactive Map==
{{Map:Lighthaos}}

==Rewards==
The game calculates how many {{Coins|Coins}}, {{Gem|Gems}} and {{Exp|}} you receive based on how many waves you survived and if you won a match. During periods of 50% more {{Exp|}} (Friday – Sunday), any {{Exp|}} earned is multiplied by 1.5x through the [[XP Boost]] modifier. The VIP [[Gamepasses|gamepass]] also multiplies any {{Exp|}} earned by 1.25x through the [[VIP Boost]] modifier. These two boosts are additive. Regular {{Exp|}} boosts are multiplicative with other modifiers present on this map.

Any rewards that end in a decimal point is rounded down, no matter the first figure of the leading decimal.

{{Rewards|Normal|Hardcore = Hide|Voidcore = Hide}}

==Strategy==
*The center of the map is the best spot for towers, as it allows them to cover most of the path.
*High range towers are pretty useful here, as the path's layout allows them to cover most of the path.
**High range cliff towers are especially useful as a tower like the [[Ranger]] can cover all of the path.
*The [[Ace Pilot]] can be pretty effective here as there are multiple spots which allow it to cover a portion of the path at all times.
